human: Could I return only one item from a bundle? The other two pieces are fine and I want to keep them?
response: Bundle returns depend on the promotion terms. If the discount was applied only when all three items were purchased together, returning one item may recalculate the price of the pieces you keep. Start a return request and review the displayed refund estimate before confirming; support can explain the calculation if it is unclear.

human: I need a copy of the information your support team has stored about my previous tickets, not just my app data.
response: Support case records are included in a separate customer-service data export. Submit the request through Privacy Centre and choose Support interactions. We will verify the account email and prepare the available ticket history, including timestamps and replies. Internal security notes and information about other customers are not included in the export.

human: I need to cancel a subscription for a former employee, but the billing owner has left and we cannot access their mailbox.
response: A company administrator can request a billing-owner change through the organisation verification process. Submit the workspace ID, your company-domain email, and a brief explanation in the Billing access form. We will verify authority before changing ownership or cancelling renewal. Do not attempt to access the former employee's personal mailbox.

human: This is my third ticket about the same invoice being marked unpaid. I already sent the transfer receipt twice and no one has fixed it.
response: I am sorry you have had to repeat the same information. I will link this request to the earlier billing cases and ask a billing specialist to reconcile the transfer against the invoice ledger. Please share the newest case number only; you do not need to resend the receipt unless the specialist asks for it.

human: The jacket fits in the shoulders but is too short in the sleeves. Can I exchange it for the next size without paying shipping twice?
response: You can request one size exchange within 30 days of delivery, provided the jacket is unworn and has its original tags. Open Orders, select Return or exchange, and choose Size exchange. We will email a prepaid label and reserve the replacement size once the parcel receives its first carrier scan.

human: Could you change the login email on my profile? I no longer use the old mailbox, but I am already signed in on my tablet.
response: You can update it from Profile Settings under Sign-in details. Enter the new address and confirm with your current password; a verification message will be sent to the new mailbox. Because you cannot access the old address, the change may be held for a support identity check. Please do not sign out of the tablet until the update is complete.

human: I was charged after I removed my card from the profile. I thought deleting it would stop the renewal.
response: Removing a payment method does not cancel an active subscription; it only removes the saved card from future checkout options. Please check Plan Settings for the subscription status and cancel it there if you no longer need it. Send us the charge reference if the renewal happened after a confirmed cancellation timestamp.

human: I chose the annual plan by mistake and intended to pay monthly. The charge happened about twenty minutes ago.
response: Please do not start a second subscription. We can review a billing correction because the purchase was made recently and the account has not used the annual features. Reply with the invoice number and confirm that you want the monthly plan instead. Any approved adjustment will be returned to the original payment method, subject to issuer processing time.

human: A sign-in alert says a login happened from another country. I am travelling, but the city listed is not where I am staying.
response: Location estimates can be imprecise, especially when mobile networks or corporate VPNs route traffic through another region. Check the alert's time and device details against your own activity. If you do not recognise the session, choose Secure account in the alert, change your password, and sign out of other sessions. We can review the event ID if needed.

human: The company newsletter went to an employee who left six months ago. Their account is disabled, so why is the email still active?
response: Newsletter distribution can use a separate mailing-list record that remains after workspace access is removed. Open Communication Settings, choose Recipients, and remove the former employee's address from the organisation list. If you cannot access that control, send the workspace ID and we will verify the mailing record.

human: My new team member can sign in but sees a blank workspace list. The invitation shows as accepted in the admin panel.
response: Ask the team member to sign out and back in, then use the workspace switcher rather than the Recent section. An accepted invitation can still be associated with a different login identity if the person has multiple email accounts. In Admin Console, confirm the membership email matches the address used for sign-in and that the member is not marked suspended.

human: My BrindleHome air sensor stopped powering on after seven months. I tried a different cable and outlet with no change.
response: The sensor has a 12-month limited warranty from the delivery date. Please send the order number, serial number from the underside label, and a short description of the troubleshooting already completed. We will issue a repair or replacement authorisation if the device passes the warranty check. Do not open the sealed casing.

human: The technician damaged the wall while installing the fibre box, and the contractor says it is not their responsibility.
response: I am sorry about the damage. Please keep photographs of the affected area and the installation appointment reference. I will open a property-damage claim with the field-service team and ask them to review the contractor report. A claims specialist will explain the documentation and assessment process within two business days.

human: A coupon code worked on the checkout screen, but the final invoice charged the regular monthly price.
response: Please send the coupon code, invoice number, and a screenshot of the checkout confirmation if you still have it. Some promotions apply only to the first billing cycle or to new workspaces, and the final invoice is the authoritative record. We will verify eligibility and correct the invoice if the discount was accepted but not applied.

human: The replacement arrived, but it is a different colour and lower specification. This does not resolve the original complaint.
response: You are right; the replacement should match the product specification you purchased. I have reopened the fulfilment complaint and requested a supervisor review of the substitution. Please send a photograph of the replacement label and the original order confirmation. We will arrange the correct model or discuss a full refund.

human: I entered my old apartment number on checkout. The parcel has not shipped yet. Can the destination be corrected?
response: We can request an address correction before the warehouse hands the parcel to the carrier. Reply with order FC-28402 and the complete corrected address, including unit number and postal code. We cannot guarantee a change after the packing scan, but we will place a hold request immediately and update you by email.

human: Calls drop whenever I enter the underground car park at work. Is there a setting that will keep them connected?
response: Underground car parks often have limited radio coverage, so a phone setting cannot guarantee a continuous call. Enable Wi-Fi Calling if your device and plan support it, and connect to a trusted building network before entering. If the building has an indoor coverage system, its facilities team may need to check the equipment.

human: I was transferred between three departments and each one says another team owns the case. Can someone coordinate this?
response: I will take ownership of the coordination and keep the related teams on one case record. The issue involves both billing and service activation, so I have assigned a lead from our resolution desk. You will receive one consolidated update within one business day instead of separate department replies.

human: The refund confirmation says the money went to a gift card, but I paid partly with a gift card and partly with cashless card payment.
response: Refunds are returned to the original tender types in the order they were used. The gift-card portion is restored to the gift balance, while the remaining amount is returned to the payment card. Open the refund breakdown in Order History to see each amount. We can resend the breakdown if it is missing.

human: I sent the wrong model back by mistake. It is still in transit to your returns centre. Can the warehouse hold it?
response: We can add a note asking the returns team to identify the parcel, but we cannot guarantee interception once it reaches the facility. Send the tracking number and the correct product model. If the wrong item is received, the warehouse will contact you before processing a refund or disposal; please keep the carrier receipt.

human: I moved to a new apartment in the same city. Can I transfer the fibre service and keep my current plan?
response: Service can usually be transferred if the new address is within our fibre coverage area. Open Move Service, enter the new unit and postal code, and choose a transfer date at least five business days ahead. We will check availability and confirm whether the existing router can be reused before scheduling the move.

human: The browser editor freezes when I paste a large table from a spreadsheet. Smaller paragraphs work fine.
response: Large tables can exceed the editor's paste-processing limit. Try pasting the table in sections of 30 to 50 rows, or import it as a CSV through Insert, then Table. Before retrying, copy your current draft to a safe location. If the editor still freezes, tell us the approximate row and column count and browser version.

human: I would like to change my account username because it contains an old project name. Does that affect links shared with clients?
response: Changing your public profile name will not change your sign-in email. Shared links that use your personal profile slug may be updated, so review any published links before confirming the change. Open Profile Settings, edit Display name, and use the preview to check how your name will appear to collaborators.

human: The gift order included a printed price slip. I selected the gift option because the recipient should not see the cost.
response: I am sorry the packing team included the wrong insert. Our gift option should include a gift note without item prices. Please share the order number and a photo of the insert with your address covered. We will record the packing issue and can email you a corrected gift receipt for the recipient.

human: Text messages arrive late by 20 or 30 minutes, while data and voice service are fine. It is affecting login codes.
response: Delayed SMS can be caused by a temporary routing issue between networks. Restart the phone, confirm the message centre setting is automatic, and test with a standard message from another VelaWave number. If delays continue, send us three example timestamps and the originating network; avoid repeatedly requesting login codes during the test.

human: I selected express delivery and paid extra, but the package came by standard post six days later.
response: The order record shows express shipping was selected, but the carrier service used was standard. We will refund the express delivery surcharge to the original payment method. The merchandise charge remains unchanged. You will receive a separate refund confirmation once billing has processed the adjustment.

human: My monthly data allowance was used up in four days, but my usage dashboard shows almost no video streaming. Could tethering be counted separately?
response: Tethered devices use the same mobile-data allowance unless your plan has a specific hotspot quota. Open Usage Details and select Daily breakdown to see which sessions consumed data. Background updates and cloud backups can also use mobile data. If the dashboard total does not match your device's counters, send us the billing-cycle dates and usage reference.

human: We are switching from five paid seats to a single seat. Can I remove everyone else without losing their comments on shared work?
response: Before removing members, transfer ownership of any assets assigned to them and export records your team must retain. Comments on shared projects remain attached to those projects, but former members lose workspace access. Reduce the seat count after removing or deactivating the four members, then confirm the change in Plan Settings.

human: The internet speed test is normal beside the router but very slow in the upstairs office. Can you send a technician?
response: The line appears to be delivering the expected speed at the router, so the issue may be Wi-Fi coverage inside the building. Try moving the router into an open central location and testing the 5 GHz network upstairs. If the signal is still weak, we can review a mesh extender option; a line technician may not resolve an indoor coverage problem.

human: I bought a chair 45 days ago and one wheel has cracked. The normal return period is over, so am I out of options?
response: The 30-day change-of-mind return period has passed, but the chair frame and supplied components have a one-year limited warranty. A cracked wheel can be reviewed as a parts claim. Send the order number and a photograph of the wheel assembly, and we will confirm whether a replacement wheel can be shipped.

human: Our VelaWave fibre connection has been dropping for two minutes at a time around 6 p.m. for the last four days.
response: We can compare your connection logs with local network events. Please note the exact times of two or three drops and whether the optical terminal's signal light changes. Avoid repeatedly resetting the router, because that removes useful diagnostics. We will check the line and arrange a technician visit if the signal levels are outside range.

human: I replaced the batteries in my wireless keyboard, but it still says 5 percent and disconnects randomly.
response: Remove the batteries for one minute, press and hold a key for ten seconds, then reinstall a matched pair with the correct polarity. Reconnect the keyboard from Bluetooth Settings and check its firmware utility for a battery-sensor update. If the displayed level remains wrong after a full power cycle, provide the keyboard model and battery type.

human: The app has started showing duplicate tasks after I imported the same calendar file twice. Is there a bulk cleanup tool?
response: Open Tasks, select the imported date range, and use the Duplicate review filter to compare matching titles and start times. You can select multiple duplicates and archive them together. Before removing anything, export the task list so you can restore a record if two similar tasks are actually distinct.

human: I cannot access the email inbox linked to my account because that provider closed the mailbox. How can I prove the account is mine?
response: We can start an assisted recovery review. Provide your account ID, the approximate account creation month, and the last successful sign-in date, but do not send payment-card details or passwords. Support may ask you to confirm a recent workspace or invoice reference. Once ownership is verified, we can help replace the inaccessible email address.

human: Could you prepare a VAT-style invoice for my company's expense records? The receipt only shows my personal name.
response: Open Billing, choose the relevant transaction, and select Edit invoice details. Add the registered business name and billing address before downloading the revised invoice. Tax identifiers can be added for future invoices, but previously issued documents may be reissued only within 30 days of the transaction. We cannot create a tax number on your behalf.

human: My parcel is addressed to me, but the courier says the postcode is invalid. The postcode is correct on the order receipt.
response: The address on your receipt is the one we transmitted to the carrier. Some carriers use a separate postcode validation database, which can lag behind local updates. Please confirm the street and locality spelling, and we will submit an address clarification. Do not post the full address publicly or send it in an unencrypted message.

human: I see a small 1.00 charge that I did not make after adding a card to my profile.
response: That amount is a temporary card verification authorisation, not a subscription fee. It is normally reversed automatically within a few business days, depending on your card issuer. You can confirm that no invoice was generated under Billing History. If the amount posts as a completed transaction and remains after seven business days, contact us with its reference.

human: My label printer feeds two blank labels before printing the actual shipping label. It started after I changed label rolls.
response: The printer may need to recalibrate to the new label gap. Load the roll with the printable side facing the correct direction, then hold Feed for five seconds until the status light flashes. Run a test print from the device menu. If it still advances extra labels, confirm the roll width and gap setting in Printer Setup.

human: Is it possible to keep my home internet active while I am away for six weeks, but suspend the monthly charge?
response: Our residential plan supports a seasonal hold for 30 to 90 days once per calendar year. Submit a Service Pause request with your preferred start and restart dates at least five business days ahead. A reduced line-maintenance fee may apply, and the connection will be unavailable during the hold.

human: Yesterday I was charged for an extra seat after a temporary contractor finished. Their account is disabled now.
response: Disabling a member prevents access but may not reduce the subscription's billed seat count until the next renewal. Open Members, remove the contractor from the workspace, then check Manage seats. If the invoice was generated after the removal, send us its number and the audit timestamp so we can verify the seat calculation.

human: The invoice lists an extra seat even though that employee left in September. I removed their access the same day.
response: Removing a member after the billing snapshot does not always reduce the seat count for the current period. Please send the invoice number and the member's removal date. We will compare the workspace audit log with the billing snapshot and confirm whether a seat adjustment is due on this invoice or the next renewal.

human: Where can I download the invoice for order CC-99207? The package only contained a return slip and no receipt.
response: Your invoice is available digitally. Sign in, open Orders, select CC-99207, and choose Download invoice. The parcel insert is not the tax invoice. If the download option is missing, reply with the email used at checkout and we can resend the document to the verified order address.

human: Would you combine two separate orders placed five minutes apart so I only pay shipping once? Neither has shipped yet.
response: Our warehouse system does not guarantee that separate orders can be combined, even when they are placed close together. We can request a consolidation before picking begins. Send both order numbers and we will check their fulfilment status; any shipping adjustment will be confirmed before we make changes.

human: I threw away the original packaging, but the item is unused and I still have the order confirmation. Can I send it back?
response: Original retail packaging is preferred but is not required for most standard returns. Place the unused item in a sturdy protective box and include any accessories and manuals. Do not write directly on the product box. Check the return portal for any category-specific packaging restrictions before handing it to the carrier.

human: The subscription was meant for one user, but the checkout created a Team workspace and invited nobody. Can I switch it?
response: We can help move the subscription to an individual plan if the Team workspace has not been used for collaboration. Please provide the workspace ID and invoice number. Do not create another subscription yet; we will confirm the available conversion and any price adjustment before changing the plan.

human: The bill includes a daily roaming pass for a country I only transited through at the airport. I never made a call.
response: Some roaming passes activate when a device registers on a partner network, even if no call is placed. Check the usage detail for the network registration timestamp and whether mobile data was enabled. If your device connected unintentionally during transit, send us the charge reference and travel timeline for a courtesy review.

human: My company card was replaced after a fraud alert and the subscription renewal is due tomorrow. Where do I update payment details?
response: An account owner can open Workspace Settings, select Billing, and choose Update payment method. Enter the replacement card details and save them before the renewal date. The new method is used for future invoices; it does not retry an older failed invoice automatically. After saving, check Billing History for the next renewal status.

human: I cannot dismiss the update banner. It comes back after every page refresh and covers the save button.
response: The banner preference may not be saving because site storage is blocked. Enable cookies and local storage for the application, dismiss the banner, and refresh once. If it returns, open Preferences, choose Notifications, and turn off Product announcements. Required security notices cannot be hidden from that setting.

human: My account says temporarily locked after several attempts. Is there a way to unlock it without waiting all day?
response: The automatic lock on BrindleDesk lasts 20 minutes after repeated failed sign-ins. Please wait until that period ends, then use the password reset link if you are unsure of the password. Further attempts during the lock can restart the timer. We can review the lock manually if it is still present after 30 minutes.

human: The mobile app says my session is offline, but videos and other apps are using the same Wi-Fi without problems.
response: Please check whether the app is allowed to use background and mobile data, and confirm that a private DNS or content filter is not blocking its sync endpoint. Toggle Wi-Fi off and on, then open the app's Network Test under Help. Send us the result code if the test fails while other sites work.

human: A report downloads as a zero-byte file only when I use one browser on my work computer; other browsers work.
response: This can happen when a browser download policy or security extension blocks the generated file. Check the download permissions for the site and ask your IT administrator whether generated CSV files are restricted. As a test, use a different supported browser. If the file is still empty, send the report ID and download timestamp.

human: How can I stop renewal when the cancel button is greyed out? The subscription was purchased through a mobile store.
response: Subscriptions purchased through a mobile app store must be managed in that store's subscription settings. Open the device's account settings, find Subscriptions, select the Avenlo entry, and choose Cancel. The app can show the current status but cannot override the store's billing controls. Keep the store confirmation for your records.

human: My e-reader will not charge from its wall adapter, but it charges when connected to my computer's USB port.
response: Try a different certified USB power adapter rated within the e-reader's input range and inspect the charging port for debris without inserting metal objects. Some adapters negotiate a charging mode the device does not support. Leave it connected for 30 minutes, then restart. If only computer charging works, send us the adapter's output rating and device firmware.

human: My notification count stays at 12 even after I open every unread message. The messages themselves show as read.
response: The badge count can lag behind the message state if the notification service has not refreshed. Open Notifications, select Mark all as read, then sign out and back in. If the badge remains, send us the workspace ID and a screenshot of the count with message content hidden so we can compare the unread-state records.

human: I paid for two-day shipping on Friday evening. Does the weekend count toward the delivery promise?
response: Our two-business-day shipping estimate starts on the next business day after the order is processed. Weekend days and public holidays are not counted, and orders placed after the 4 p.m. warehouse cutoff begin processing on the following business day. Your confirmation email lists the estimated delivery date based on that schedule.

human: Why does the app ask for access to my contacts when I only use it to manage project tasks? Is that required?
response: Contact access is optional and is used only to suggest collaborators from your address book. You can deny the permission and still create tasks, invite people by entering their work email, and use existing projects. Revoke the permission in your device settings if it was previously granted.

human: The smart thermostat is online but does not respond to temperature changes from the wall panel. The phone app can still control it.
response: The wall panel may have lost its local pairing with the controller. Open Settings on the panel, select Reconnect to hub, and follow the pairing prompt while standing near the controller. Do not factory-reset the thermostat yet, because that can remove schedules. If pairing fails, share the panel and hub firmware versions.

human: A replacement part arrived, but it is the wrong revision and does not fit my 2024 unit.
response: Please compare the revision printed on the replacement package with the model code on your device. We will check the compatibility table and send the correct revision if the part was selected in error. Include photographs of both model labels; do not modify the connector to make the part fit.

human: I have spent two hours trying to reach a person about a device that arrived broken. The chatbot keeps sending me to the same form.
response: I am sorry the automated route has not helped. I have moved this conversation to the product-claims queue so a person can review the damaged-item report. Please provide the order number and one photograph of the damage if you have not already uploaded them. You should not need to submit another form.

human: The handheld scanner pairs with my tablet but disconnects as soon as I walk about three metres away. It used to work across the room.
response: Please charge the scanner fully and check that no other paired host is reconnecting automatically. Remove the old pairing on both devices, restart them, and pair again from the scanner's Bluetooth menu. Keep the scanner away from metal shelving during the test. If range remains limited, provide its firmware version and serial prefix.

human: I get error E-417 every time I attach a PDF larger than 8 MB, although the help page says 20 MB is allowed.
response: The workspace limit is 20 MB per file, but the current browser uploader may reject a file when the connection drops during transfer. Try a stable network and a different browser, and confirm the PDF is not password-protected. If the error persists, send the file size, browser version, and upload request ID from the error details.

human: Can you split the 240.00 invoice into two payments? Our purchasing department releases funds in two stages.
response: The current self-service checkout does not support instalments on a single invoice. A billing administrator can request a payment schedule review by sharing the invoice number and the dates your department can pay. The invoice remains due until an approved arrangement is recorded, so please contact us before the due date to avoid an automatic service restriction.

human: Search stopped finding words inside older PDFs even though those documents are still visible in the folder.
response: Older PDFs may not have completed text indexing. Open the document menu, choose Reindex content, and leave the workspace open while processing runs. Scanned PDFs require text recognition and may take longer than ordinary files. If indexing reports a failure, send us the document ID and the error code, not the document's confidential contents.

human: The plan comparison says unlimited exports, but my account has a monthly export cap. Which one applies?
response: The unlimited export feature is included only in the Studio plan, while the Starter and Plus plans have monthly caps. Please check the exact plan name under Subscription Overview; an add-on does not change the base plan's export allowance. If your account shows Studio and still blocks exports, we can inspect its entitlement record.

human: I never receive the one-time code by text. The number is correct and ordinary messages are arriving normally.
response: Please wait 60 seconds before requesting another code, since repeated requests invalidate earlier messages. In Security Settings, check that text-message verification is selected rather than an authenticator app. If the code still does not arrive, choose Use a recovery method and try an email code. Our system will temporarily pause text delivery after five requests in ten minutes.

human: Please stop order processing if possible; I noticed the delivery address is my previous workplace.
response: We can attempt cancellation while the order remains in processing, but warehouse release can happen quickly. Select Cancel order under Order Details and choose Address entered incorrectly. If the button is unavailable, reply with the order number immediately and we will request a stop. A parcel already collected by the carrier cannot be recalled reliably.

human: I received a text saying my SIM will be suspended unless I update registration details through a link. Is this from VelaWave?
response: Do not open the link or enter personal information. We do not request SIM registration through unsolicited shortened links. Open the VelaWave app directly and check Account Notices, or call the support number printed on your bill. Forward the message to our abuse-reporting address so our security team can review the sender.

human: Is there a way to transfer the remaining months of my annual plan to a new workspace after our department reorganises?
response: Subscriptions are attached to a workspace and cannot be transferred directly between separate organisations. An owner can invite the new department to the existing workspace or request a workspace migration review. Share both workspace IDs and the intended move date, and we will explain which plan credits and settings can be carried over.

human: I am an admin and need an audit log of who viewed a confidential folder during the last quarter.
response: Workspace owners on the Business tier can export folder access events from Admin Console, under Security, then Audit Log. Set the date range to the last quarter and filter by the folder ID. The export includes view, download, and permission-change events where recorded. If your plan does not show this option, ask us about the audit-log add-on.

human: Your website showed the product as in stock when I paid, but now support says there is no stock and offers store credit only.
response: We should not limit the resolution to store credit when the order cannot be fulfilled. I will ask a supervisor to review the stock discrepancy and offer the available refund or replacement options under the order terms. Please send the order number and the product variant shown at checkout.

human: The new plan includes international minutes, but my call to a number abroad was charged at the standard rate.
response: International minutes apply only to the countries listed in your plan's destination group and exclude premium or special-service numbers. Open Plan Details, select International calling, and check the included destinations. Send us the dialled country code and charge reference if the destination is listed but was billed separately.

human: My notes appear on my laptop but not on the browser version, even after refreshing. Both show the same workspace name.
response: Check that both clients are signed in to the same account email and workspace ID; similar workspace names can be misleading. On the laptop, open Sync Status and select Retry pending changes. Keep the app open while it syncs. If one note remains missing, send its local record ID from the note details panel.

human: Our connection becomes unusable when three people join video meetings at once, even though the plan is advertised as 300 Mbps.
response: The advertised speed is the maximum connection rate, not a guarantee for every device under all conditions. Check whether the speed test is wired or wireless and whether uploads are saturated during meetings. A router with traffic prioritisation may help. Send us wired download and upload results at a quiet time so we can rule out a line issue.

human: Our team cannot open shared links from the notification emails. The page says the link is malformed.
response: The email security gateway may be rewriting the link and truncating its token. Copy the full link address rather than the visible text, and try opening it in a browser where you are already signed in. If it still fails, ask the sender to create a fresh share link with a seven-day expiry and send us the link ID.

human: The technician missed the appointment again, and I had to take another half day off work. I need someone to own this issue.
response: I understand why another missed visit is unacceptable. I am escalating the case to our field-service supervisor and including both appointment references. We will contact you by the end of the next business day with a confirmed plan, rather than asking you to book another visit through the standard queue.

human: The refund email says 42.00 was returned, while the original payment was 48.00. What happened to the difference?
response: The refund covers the eligible product amount after a 6.00 non-refundable delivery fee shown in the order terms. The receipt's refund line should list the returned amount and the retained fee separately. If the original order did not include that fee, send us the order number and we will review the calculation.

human: I deleted my old phone number from the profile, and now the security page will not let me add the replacement number.
response: For safety, changing a recovery number places the account in a 24-hour cooldown. Once the cooldown ends, open Security Settings, choose Recovery phone, and enter the new number in international format. You will need to confirm the six-digit code sent to it. The cooldown cannot be shortened by support.

human: The eSIM installation says the activation code has already been used. I scanned it once, and setup failed halfway through.
response: An eSIM activation code is generally single-use, even when setup does not finish. Connect to Wi-Fi, open Mobile Settings, and check whether the VelaWave profile was added before scanning again. If no profile appears, request a replacement activation code in the app. Do not delete an installed profile until support confirms it is inactive.

human: The router's broadband light is green, but every device says connected without internet. The outage map shows no incident.
response: Please power-cycle the modem and router in that order: switch both off, wait 30 seconds, power the modem on, and wait until its broadband light stabilises before restarting the router. If the issue remains, connect one computer directly to the router by Ethernet and run Network Check. Share the result code so we can test the session.

human: I changed my marketing preference to off, but the mobile app still shows a promotional notification on the home screen.
response: Email marketing and in-app promotional notices are controlled separately. Open Notification Settings, choose Offers and product news, and disable the in-app option. This does not turn off operational alerts such as security warnings or service interruptions. Restart the app once to refresh the preference.

human: I am getting a warning that my session expired every few minutes, even while I am actively editing a document.
response: Check whether your device clock is set automatically; a large time difference can invalidate BrindleDesk sessions. Also allow first-party cookies for the application and temporarily disable privacy extensions to test. If the issue continues in another browser, send us the browser version and the approximate time of a failed session so we can inspect the session logs.

human: Our organisation wants to remove one user's records but retain the shared projects and comments they created. Is that possible?
response: An administrator can deactivate the member and transfer ownership of shared assets before requesting personal-data deletion. Shared project history may retain the creator's name or an anonymised attribution where required for audit integrity. Open Admin Console, select the member, and choose Offboarding review so we can explain the available retention options.

human: My statement shows two charges of 18.50 from VellumNote on the same afternoon. The invoice page only lists one purchase.
response: Please compare the two entries' posting dates and reference IDs; one may be a pending authorisation that will disappear when your bank releases it. In Billing, download the invoice for the completed charge. If both entries post as settled after five business days, send us the transaction references and we will investigate the duplicate.

human: The barcode reader types every character twice into our inventory form. It works correctly in the manufacturer's test utility.
response: The reader may be configured for a keyboard repeat or duplicate-scan mode. Open the scanner configuration menu, disable Continuous Scan, and set the inter-scan delay to 300 milliseconds. Test in a plain text editor before returning to the inventory form. If duplicate characters remain, send us the configuration profile name.

human: The return portal only offers store credit, but I paid by debit card and want the refund sent back to that card.
response: Store credit is the default option shown for exchanges, but eligible standard returns can be refunded to the original payment method. Return to the refund preference step and select Original payment method. If that option is missing, send us the order number and we will check whether the item category has a different return rule.

human: Can you ship my replacement charger to a different country from the original order? I am visiting family for the next month.
response: Replacement orders can be sent only to countries supported by our fulfilment network. Tell us the destination country and postal code, and we will check service availability and any customs requirements. If delivery is not supported there, we can ship to the original address or discuss a refund instead.

human: The courier attempted delivery at 7 a.m. and marked it failed, even though the delivery window was after noon.
response: I am sorry the carrier arrived outside the selected window. We have added a delivery instruction requesting an afternoon attempt, although the carrier controls the final route. Use the tracking page's Reschedule option if it is available. If the parcel returns to the depot, contact us before the next delivery attempt so we can coordinate.

human: I ordered two linen covers but the parcel contained one cover and a set of cushion inserts. The packing slip lists both covers.
response: That is not the order you placed, and I apologise for the packing error. Please send a photo of the items received and the packing slip through the order page. We will ship the missing cover and provide a prepaid return label for the incorrect inserts if a return is required; no additional payment will be taken.

human: My child has an account under our family plan, and I need to update the parent contact email without changing the child's login.
response: The family contact address is separate from each member's sign-in address. Sign in as the family organiser, open Family Settings, and edit Parent contact. Confirm the new address using the verification message. This change will not alter the child's username, saved settings, or login credentials.

human: I want to object to my support chat being used to improve the help assistant. Where is that preference?
response: Open Privacy Centre, choose AI assistance preferences, and turn off Use support conversations to improve assistance. This affects future eligible conversations after the change is processed; it does not automatically remove records already retained under the service's data policy. You can separately submit a deletion or access request from the same page.

human: I asked for an accessibility accommodation in my first ticket and the agent ignored it. I cannot complete the verification steps they keep sending.
response: I am sorry we did not account for your accessibility request. I have escalated the case to our accessibility support queue so the verification method can be reviewed with you. Please tell us which communication format works best, such as email or a scheduled call. We will not ask you to repeat an inaccessible step while the review is pending.

human: Why is this device marked untrusted every time I reopen the app, even though I selected remember this device?
response: The trusted-device setting relies on a browser cookie or the app's local secure storage. Check that your browser clears site data on exit and that device-cleaning software is not removing application data. In the app, update to the latest version and enable Remember this device again. Shared or public devices are intentionally not eligible for persistent trust.

human: Since yesterday's update, the desktop app closes whenever I export a report with more than 200 rows.
response: This may be an export memory issue introduced in the latest build. As a workaround, export in smaller date ranges of roughly 100 rows each. Please open Help, select Send diagnostics, and include the application version and operating system. We have logged the crash for review; do not reinstall until the diagnostic bundle has finished uploading.

human: The return courier scanned my parcel as collected, then lost it. The store says it never arrived and refuses the refund.
response: The collection scan confirms the parcel entered the courier network. We will open a return-transit investigation using your return reference and collection receipt. Please retain the receipt until the case closes. You do not need to start another return; we will coordinate with the carrier and update you within three business days.

human: The delivery estimate moved from Tuesday to Friday twice. Is the stock actually available or is this a backorder?
response: The item was in stock when your order was placed, but the fulfilment centre has since reported a picking delay. Your order is not marked as backordered. We will request a confirmed dispatch date and email you within one business day. You may cancel for a full refund before the parcel is handed to the carrier.

human: Why is the amount on my receipt slightly higher than the price shown on the plan page?
response: The plan page displays the base price before any applicable local taxes. Your receipt separates the subscription amount from taxes calculated using the billing address on file. Open the invoice PDF to see the tax rate and billing jurisdiction. If the address is outdated, update it in Billing Profile before the next renewal.

human: A firmware update on my VelaMesh access point stopped at 70 percent. The power light is still on, but the network is down.
response: Do not unplug the access point while its status light is pulsing; the update may still be writing firmware. Wait 10 minutes, then check whether the light becomes steady. If it remains stalled, use the documented recovery button sequence for hardware revision B in the setup guide. Contact support before attempting a manual firmware flash.

human: The technician visit was marked complete, but nobody came to the property and the connection is still down.
response: I apologise for the incorrect completion status. We will reopen the fault and check the technician's route notes against the appointment address. Please confirm a suitable access window and whether the building requires entry instructions. We will provide a new appointment reference once dispatch has assigned the visit.

human: Can this analytics add-on be stopped while I keep access to my files? Is it separate from the main subscription?
response: Analytics is a separate add-on and can be cancelled without ending the base subscription. Open Plan Settings, select Add-ons, and choose Remove beside Analytics. The feature remains available until the end of the paid add-on period, after which reports become read-only for 30 days before scheduled removal.

human: Someone appears to have changed my display name and added a recovery number I don't recognise. What should I do first?
response: Treat this as a possible account compromise. From a device you trust, change your password, choose Security, and select Sign out of all sessions. Remove the unfamiliar recovery number and review recent sign-in activity. If you cannot make those changes, reply with the approximate time you noticed them and we will restrict the account while verifying ownership.

human: The payment failed, but the amount is still showing as pending with my card issuer. Should I try paying again?
response: A failed checkout can leave a temporary authorisation even when no payment was captured. Check Billing History before retrying; if there is no paid invoice, the authorisation normally releases within three to seven business days depending on the issuer. To avoid a second attempt, wait for the payment status to update or use another method only after confirming no completed charge exists.

human: The setup wizard cannot find my 2.4 GHz network, although my phone and laptop can see it. The router combines both bands under one name.
response: Some older devices cannot join a combined-band network during initial setup. Temporarily create a separate 2.4 GHz guest network with WPA2 security and a simple network name, then connect the device to that network. Complete setup before changing any router settings back. Do not use an open network or share the guest password publicly.

human: Order FC-27184 has been stuck at 'label created' for four days. The parcel was supposed to arrive yesterday.
response: A label-created scan means the carrier has received shipment information but may not have collected the parcel yet. We have requested a dispatch check from the warehouse. Please allow one business day for the first physical scan; if none appears, we will arrange a replacement shipment or refund based on stock availability.

human: Before closing my Avenlo account, I want to download every note and attachment. Is there one export for everything?
response: Yes. Open Privacy Centre, choose Download my data, and select All content, including attachments. The export is prepared as a password-protected archive and we email a download link when it is ready, usually within 48 hours. The link expires after seven days, so save the archive securely.

human: I sent the requested documents a week ago and the verification status has not changed. There is no explanation in the portal.
response: I apologise for the lack of an update. I have asked the verification team to confirm whether the documents were received and whether anything is missing. We will provide a status update within two business days. Please do not upload the same documents again unless the team confirms the original files were unreadable.

human: I cancelled yesterday but the account still shows Premium and lists a renewal date in December. Has the cancellation failed?
response: Your cancellation is scheduled successfully. Premium access continues until the paid-through date shown in the account, and the renewal date remains visible for reference. The status should read Cancels on [date] rather than Active renewal. Check the confirmation email as well; contact us with its reference if the account still says it will renew.

human: The charging case for my earbuds gets warm in my bag even when the earbuds are already full.
response: Remove the case from the bag and place it on a non-flammable surface until it returns to room temperature. Check for debris or moisture around the charging contacts and do not charge it if the case is swollen, leaking, or unusually hot. Contact us with the serial number for a safety assessment; do not continue using a suspect battery.

human: The parcel locker sent a pickup code, but the locker screen says the compartment is empty. I have 24 hours left to collect it.
response: Please take a photograph of the locker number and the empty-compartment message, without including the pickup code. Contact the locker operator using the help option on the screen so the compartment can be checked. We have also opened a carrier case; the collection deadline will be paused while the missing-parcel report is investigated.

human: My USB audio interface produces a pop whenever I connect headphones while the computer is running.
response: Turn the monitor output level down before connecting headphones, and avoid inserting the plug while audio is actively playing. Check that the headphones use the correct stereo connector and that the interface driver is current. If the pop occurs even with output muted, disconnect the interface and contact support with its model and firmware version.

human: I started the 14-day trial but the product asks for a card. Will it charge me immediately?
response: Adding a payment method does not start a charge during the trial. The trial ends on the date shown in Plan Settings, and the selected monthly plan begins automatically unless you cancel beforehand. You can cancel under Subscription, then Manage trial. We send a reminder three days before conversion when a valid email is on the account.

human: The desktop client keeps asking me to install an update, but the installer says a newer version is already present on this computer.
response: The updater may be reading a different installation path from the running client. Close all application windows, open About to note the installed version, and check whether the app is installed for your user or for all users. Send the installer log from Help, then we can provide the correct update package for that installation type.

human: The camera on my meeting display has a pink tint after I connected a new HDMI cable. The image is otherwise sharp.
response: Check the display's input colour format and set it to Auto or RGB rather than a manually selected YCbCr mode. Reseat both ends of the HDMI cable and test another certified cable. If the tint appears on the built-in camera preview too, reset Camera Settings to default and send us the firmware version.

human: The refund was denied because the return was late, but the courier tracking proves I handed it over before the deadline.
response: We can review the handover scan rather than the warehouse arrival date. Please provide the return reference and the first carrier collection timestamp. I will ask the returns team to compare it with the policy deadline and reopen the refund decision if the parcel was handed over in time.

human: Your agent promised a replacement by Monday, but the case was closed and nothing has arrived. Can you reopen it?
response: Yes. The case was closed before the replacement shipment was confirmed, which should not have happened. I have reopened it and requested the fulfilment reference from the warehouse. We will send you the dispatch details or an alternative resolution within one business day.

human: I cancelled my old mobile number but forgot that a delivery service still sends codes to it. Can the number be restored?
response: A disconnected number may be recoverable for a limited quarantine period, but restoration is not guaranteed after reassignment. Please contact us with the old number and the disconnection date through a verified support channel. Do not include it in a public post. We will check the number status before discussing any reactivation option.

human: The cookie banner keeps returning every time I open the site, even though I selected reject optional cookies last week.
response: Your choice is stored in a browser cookie, so clearing site data or using private browsing can reset the banner. Select Reject optional cookies again and make sure the browser allows essential site storage. Your selection does not affect cookies required for sign-in or account security.

human: Please pause my subscription for two months while our office is closed. I don't want to cancel and rebuild everything later.
response: Avenlo offers a pause option on monthly plans, with a maximum pause of 60 days once per subscription year. Open Subscription Settings, choose Pause plan, and select the restart date. Your workspace becomes read-only during the pause, but stored projects remain available. Annual plans cannot currently be paused; we can check whether a renewal-date change is available instead.

human: I returned a pair of shoes three weeks ago and the tracking says your warehouse received them, but there is no refund.
response: The warehouse receipt scan is recorded, and returns are normally inspected within five business days. Once inspection is complete, the refund is sent to the original payment method and may take another five to ten business days to appear. Send us your return reference if the status has not changed after the inspection window.

human: A privacy dashboard says my data is processed in two regions. Can I choose to keep everything in one region?
response: Data residency options depend on the workspace plan and the services enabled. Open Workspace Settings, select Data residency, and review the available region choices. Some support, security, and billing records may be processed in other regions as described in the data-processing terms. We can provide a workspace-specific assessment if you share its ID.

human: The warranty form asks for a serial number, but the sticker has peeled off and I cannot read the last four characters.
response: Please do not guess the missing characters. Check the original product box or the device information screen, where the full serial number may also appear. If neither is available, submit the warranty form with the order number and attach a clear photo of the remaining label. Our team can check the purchase record.

human: The device's temperature warning appears after about ten minutes of video playback. The case feels warm but not hot.
response: Move the device out of direct sunlight, remove any thick protective cover, and place it on a hard surface with ventilation. Close background applications and install the latest firmware. If the warning continues at room temperature, stop playback and send us the warning code and device serial prefix so we can check its thermal logs.

human: The repair centre says my device has liquid damage, but it has never been wet. I want the assessment reviewed.
response: You can request a second assessment within 10 days of receiving the repair report. Reply with the service case number and explain where the device was stored and used. We will arrange for another technician to inspect the corrosion indicators and provide a written finding. The original report remains available while the review is underway.

human: My order confirmation shows a blue desk lamp, but the dispatch email lists the graphite model. Which one is actually coming?
response: The dispatch record currently shows the graphite model, which does not match your confirmation. We have asked the warehouse to stop the parcel before collection. Please do not place another order; we will confirm whether the correct colour can be substituted or whether a refund is the better option.

human: A renewal happened today, but I meant to cancel at the end of last month. I cannot see a cancellation confirmation in my inbox.
response: Without a completed cancellation record, the subscription renews on its scheduled date. We can check your account's plan activity and notification history. Please provide the workspace ID and the date you attempted cancellation. If a service error prevented the request from saving, we will review the renewal for an adjustment.

human: I am travelling overseas next week. Will my current mobile plan receive verification texts while roaming?
response: Your plan supports incoming SMS in most roaming partner networks, but availability depends on the destination carrier. Incoming text charges may differ by country. Check Travel Settings for the supported-network list and enable roaming before departure. For account security, keep an authenticator or recovery method available in case SMS delivery is delayed.

human: After restoring an older backup, the app reports a database schema mismatch. How should I recover it?
response: The backup was created by a version older than the current app's supported migration range. Reinstalling will not repair the backup itself. Please keep a copy of the original file, then open Help, choose Backup recovery, and upload the version number and backup metadata. We will identify the supported upgrade path before you retry the restore.

human: A former contractor still appears as a data processor in our workspace privacy report. Their account was removed months ago.
response: The report includes historical access events as well as current members. Open the report's Activity date filter and select Current access to see active processors. If the contractor appears in that view, send us the workspace ID and member record ID so we can verify whether an access permission remains.

human: I upgraded from Basic to Studio halfway through the month. The dashboard says Studio, but some features remain unavailable.
response: The upgrade may take a few minutes to propagate across active sessions. Sign out, sign back in, and check that you are in the workspace that was upgraded. If the feature remains locked after 15 minutes, send us the workspace ID and upgrade receipt so we can compare the subscription entitlement with the feature service.

human: My colleague left the company and was the only workspace owner. We need to add a new administrator before payroll closes.
response: A workspace with no active owner requires an ownership review. Please have an authorised company contact submit the workspace ID and a business-domain email address through the ownership request form in Help Center. We will verify the organisation and respond within two business days. Do not share the former employee's password or ask them to transfer their personal login.

human: I subscribed to the quarterly option, but the account page says the next payment is in one month.
response: The plan may have been created as monthly rather than quarterly. Open Billing History and inspect the latest invoice's service dates; those dates identify the actual billing interval. Send us the invoice number and a screenshot of the plan summary, with personal payment details hidden, and we can correct the plan if checkout selected the wrong interval.

human: The trial converted overnight even though I thought I had cancelled it from the mobile app. Can you help reverse the first payment?
response: I can review the conversion and cancellation records. Please share the account email and the approximate time you tapped cancel, without sending your password. If the cancellation attempt failed before the trial ended, we will check whether the first charge qualifies for a reversal under the 48-hour trial-conversion review window.

human: I uploaded a photo from my phone and it appears rotated sideways in the browser gallery. The original looks fine.
response: The gallery may be ignoring the orientation metadata stored in the photo. Open the image in the mobile app, choose Edit details, and select Correct orientation before uploading it again. If the original file is already stored in the gallery, remove that copy only after confirming the corrected upload is visible.

human: The battery indicator on my BrindleTab drops from 40 percent to zero in a few minutes, but the device works normally when plugged in.
response: A sudden percentage drop can indicate a battery calibration or battery-health problem. Install the latest firmware, charge the tablet uninterrupted to 100 percent, and restart it once. In Settings, open Battery Health and send us the reported capacity. If the tablet shuts down again, stop relying on it for critical work and arrange a warranty assessment.

human: Our free trial was extended by your agent, but the original end date is still shown on the billing page.
response: The account may be showing a cached date. Refresh the billing page after signing out and back in, then check the Trial details section for the revised end date. If the old date remains, reply with the support case number that approved the extension; we can verify the subscription record directly.

human: My VelaMesh router loses its 5 GHz network every evening, while the 2.4 GHz network remains visible. Restarting fixes it for a while.
response: First check whether the router is overheating or placed inside a closed cabinet. In Wireless Settings, try a fixed 5 GHz channel rather than Auto and apply the change during a quiet period. Update firmware from Administration, then monitor the event log. If the radio drops again, send us the log around the failure time and the router hardware revision.

human: Our network printer shows paper jam even when the feed path is clear. The warning returns immediately after I restart it.
response: Open every access panel and check the rear duplex path, including the small paper sensor flag near the output rollers. Use the release tabs rather than pulling forcefully. With the printer powered off, remove any scraps using tweezers designed for maintenance. If the sensor remains stuck, stop and arrange service to avoid damaging the feed mechanism.

human: Our finance team needs a copy of every invoice from the last financial year. Downloading each month is taking ages.
response: Workspace owners can export invoice history in one file. Open Billing, choose Documents, set the date range to the previous financial year, and select Export CSV. PDF invoices remain available individually from the same page. The export link expires after 24 hours, so save the file to your approved company storage.

human: The case was marked resolved even though the app still crashes. I replied to the closure email, but nobody responded.
response: I have reopened the technical case and linked your reply to the original incident. Please send the app version and the approximate time of the most recent crash if those details have changed. The engineering team will review the existing diagnostics, and we will keep the case open until you confirm the issue is resolved.

human: My profile contains an old home address. I removed it, but it still appears in a support form autofill field.
response: The support form may be using your browser's saved address rather than your account profile. Clear the form's autofill entry in the browser settings, then reload the page. To check account records, open Profile, select Personal details, and review the saved address fields. If the address remains there, send us the field name, not the full address.

human: I accidentally shared a folder with a public link. I disabled the link, but I need to know whether anyone accessed it.
response: Open the folder's Sharing History and review link access events for the period when it was active. Disabling the link prevents new access but does not erase prior access logs. If the folder contained sensitive material, notify your workspace administrator and share the link ID with our security team for a review.

human: I bought a data add-on, received confirmation, but the account still says I have zero gigabytes remaining.
response: Add-on balances can take up to five minutes to appear. Toggle mobile data off and on, then refresh Usage Details. Make sure the add-on was purchased for the same SIM and billing account you are viewing. If it remains missing, send the purchase reference and we will verify the allocation.

human: Yesterday I expected a callback, but nobody contacted me. The phone number on my profile is correct.
response: I apologise for the missed callback. I have flagged the case with the contact-centre lead and requested a new callback window. Please confirm whether morning or afternoon is more convenient and include your local time zone. We will also send an email update so you are not dependent on the call.

human: My warranty claim was closed because the purchase date could not be verified. I bought it from one of your authorised resellers.
response: We can reopen the claim with alternate proof of purchase. Please upload the reseller receipt showing the retailer name, transaction date, and product model. You may cover unrelated items and payment details. We will verify the reseller record and update the warranty start date if the documentation matches.

human: Can you tell me which third-party services receive our workspace data? Our compliance team needs a vendor list.
response: The current list of subprocessors is available from Privacy Centre under Service providers. It includes each provider's role, processing region, and the type of information used. Workspace owners can download the list as a PDF. For a contract-specific question, submit the vendor review request with your workspace ID and we will route it to the privacy team.

human: My broadband contract ended, but the portal says I will pay an early termination fee if I leave this month.
response: The contract end date and the service renewal date can be different. Open Agreement Details and check the minimum-term end date, not just the introductory discount end date. If the minimum term has passed and the fee remains, send us the account reference and a screenshot of the dates so we can review the charge.

human: The smart plug clicks repeatedly and the status light flashes red when I connect a space heater. Is the plug faulty?
response: Disconnect the heater immediately and do not keep testing it. The smart plug is rated for resistive loads up to 10 amps, and some heaters exceed that limit or have a high startup load. Check the heater's rated current before using any smart plug. If the plug clicks with no load attached, contact us for a safety inspection.

human: I requested a data export yesterday and the status still says preparing. There is no download link yet.
response: Large exports can take up to 48 hours, especially when the account contains many attachments. The export status page updates automatically when the archive is ready, and a notification is sent to the verified email. Please avoid starting another export, which may place a second job in the queue. Contact us after the stated window if it remains preparing.

human: I forgot the administrator PIN on the home hub. I can still control lights from the paired phone, but cannot change settings.
response: The hub's administrator PIN can be reset using the physical reset button. Hold it for 12 seconds until the status light pulses amber, then follow the setup flow in the companion app. This preserves paired device history but clears administrator credentials and network configuration. Make sure you have the Wi-Fi password before starting.

human: The replacement headphones have the same left-channel crackle as the first pair. This is the second failure in a month.
response: I am sorry the replacement has not resolved the fault. We can escalate this as a repeat warranty failure and offer a refund review instead of sending another identical unit. Please share both service reference numbers and confirm whether the crackle occurs with more than one source device.

human: I unsubscribed from product announcements, but I still receive a monthly tips newsletter. Are those settings separate?
response: Yes. Product announcements and the monthly tips newsletter use separate preferences. Open Communication Settings, expand Newsletters, and turn off Monthly tips. Your change may take up to five business days to reach the mailing system, so one message already queued may still arrive.

human: The new editor changed my date format to month first, but our team records dates day first. Can I set this per workspace?
response: Date display can be configured at workspace level. An owner can open Workspace Settings, choose Locale, and set the date format to DD/MM/YYYY. Individual browser language preferences will no longer override that choice. Refresh open editor tabs after saving to apply the new format consistently.

human: The support response says to restart the router, but I have already done that four times and sent the diagnostic logs.
response: Thank you for pointing that out; repeating the same step is not useful. I will review the existing logs and escalate the fault to network diagnostics. Please leave the router connected so the team can observe the line. We will reply with a specific finding or a technician recommendation, not another generic restart instruction.

human: Your service outage lasted all weekend. I am not asking for a full refund, but I expect some credit on next month's bill.
response: We can assess a service credit once the outage duration and affected account are confirmed. Please share the incident reference or the dates and approximate times when service was unavailable. If the outage meets the credit policy, the adjustment will appear as a separate line on the next bill or be issued sooner where required.

human: I have been charged a late fee even though the payment portal was unavailable on the due date. I have a screenshot with the error time.
response: We can review the fee against the portal incident window. Please provide the invoice number and the timestamp shown in your screenshot, with unrelated account details hidden. I will attach the evidence to a billing escalation and request a fee reversal if the outage prevented payment before the deadline.

human: My portable monitor has a faint flicker when powered through the laptop, but not when I use its own adapter.
response: The laptop's USB-C port may not supply stable power while also driving the display. Connect the monitor's supplied power adapter, then use the USB-C cable for video and data. Try another full-featured USB-C cable if flicker continues. Please confirm the laptop port supports DisplayPort Alt Mode before ordering a replacement cable.

human: The calendar page is blank in one browser, but the rest of the site works. I cleared history and signed in again already.
response: Please check whether content blockers or cross-site tracking restrictions are preventing the calendar module from loading. Allow site storage for the MorrowBoard domain, then reload the page. If that does not help, test in another supported browser and send us the console error text from the blank page, with any session tokens removed.

human: After the latest release, keyboard shortcuts work in the editor but not in the task list. Did the mappings change?
response: The task-list shortcuts were moved to a separate setting in the latest release. Open Preferences, choose Keyboard, and enable Task list shortcuts. You can view the current key map there and restore the previous layout. If the option is missing, tell us your app version and operating system.

human: An email alert says a new device exported my data. I did not request an export and want to know what was downloaded.
response: Please secure the account first by changing your password and signing out of all sessions. Then open Security Activity and review the export event's device and time details. If you do not recognise it, use Report activity and share the event ID with us. We can revoke the export link if it has not expired.

human: A refurbished tablet arrived instead of the new condition listed on the invoice. The box label also says certified refurbished.
response: The delivered condition does not match your order. Please keep the packaging and upload photographs of the tablet label and invoice through Order Help. We will arrange collection at no cost and offer the correct new unit if stock is available, or a full refund if it is not.

human: Order RC-55219 says partial shipment, but there is no second tracking number and the missing item is the main part of the set.
response: The order has been split because the main set is stored at a different fulfilment centre. The second parcel has not received its carrier scan yet. We have requested its dispatch confirmation and will send the tracking reference when it is created. If it cannot leave within two business days, we will contact you about alternatives.

human: I edited a shared document offline on a train. Now the app says there is a conflict and offers two versions.
response: Do not choose either version until you have reviewed both. Open the conflict panel, compare the local and server timestamps, and copy any unique text into a temporary note. You can then select Keep both to preserve each version. Once the document is safely merged, reconnect and wait for the green Synced indicator.

human: The box arrived this morning, but the ceramic kettle inside is shattered and glass pieces were loose in the packaging.
response: I am sorry the kettle arrived in that condition. Please do not handle the loose pieces; keep the packaging until the claim is recorded. Upload photos of the outer box, inner padding, and damaged item through Order Help. We will arrange a no-cost replacement or refund, and you do not need to return broken glass.

human: Our design team has six people this month, but next quarter we will need only four seats. Can I reduce the plan now?
response: Yes. A workspace owner can open Plan Settings, choose Manage seats, and lower the seat count to four. The reduction takes effect at the next renewal, while the current period remains unchanged. Remove or reassign any active seats first so the selected count is not lower than the number of assigned members.

human: The invite says my email is already registered, but I have never used CairnDesk. The invitation is for a different company.
response: An email address can belong to only one CairnDesk identity, but that identity can join multiple workspaces. Sign in with the existing account, open the workspace switcher, and accept the invitation there. If you do not recognise the account, use password recovery first and contact us with the invitation code so we can check its destination.

human: The power adapter failed, but I bought the device second-hand. Can the warranty still cover the adapter?
response: The standard warranty is linked to the original proof of purchase and is not automatically transferable. We can still check whether the adapter is covered by a separate safety replacement programme. Please provide the model number and the original purchase date if known; do not use an adapter that is overheating or visibly damaged.

human: The tracking timeline shows the package went to the wrong regional depot, about 300 kilometres away. Is that normal?
response: A parcel can be routed through an intermediate depot that is not close to the destination. The carrier has marked this as an onward-routing scan, not a delivery attempt. Please allow 24 hours for the next scan. If the parcel remains at that depot beyond then, we will ask the carrier to trace it.

human: We need to move from the monthly Team plan to annual billing, but I cannot find an annual option in the mobile app.
response: Annual billing changes are available in the web workspace, not in the mobile application. Sign in through a browser, open Billing, select Change plan, and choose Annual. The page will show the renewal date and any credit for the unused portion of the monthly period before you confirm.

human: The tracking says delivered to reception, but my building has no reception desk and the parcel is nowhere in the lobby.
response: Please check with neighbours and the building manager, and look around any parcel lockers or sheltered entrances. Our carrier's proof-of-delivery record may include a photograph or drop-off note. Report the parcel as missing from Order Help within 48 hours of the delivery scan so we can open a carrier investigation.

human: I do not want another troubleshooting checklist. I want a written explanation of why my account was suspended and what evidence is needed to appeal.
response: I understand. I will request a manual review from the account-integrity team and ask for a written explanation of the suspension category, the appeal process, and any information you are permitted to provide. We cannot disclose internal detection rules, but we can explain the next steps and the documents needed for an appeal.

human: Please delete my account and all information associated with it. I have already cancelled the paid plan.
response: We can begin account deletion after confirming that the subscription is cancelled and you are the account owner. Open Privacy Centre, choose Delete account, and complete the email verification. Some billing records may be retained for legally required accounting periods, but your profile and workspace content will be scheduled for deletion under the published retention policy.

human: A refund was approved for a cancelled booking, but nothing has appeared on my debit card after eight days.
response: The refund was submitted to the original payment method on 23 October. Card issuers commonly take five to ten business days after submission to post it, excluding weekends and holidays. Please check the original card account rather than a replacement card number. If it is still missing after the tenth business day, we can provide the refund trace reference.

human: If I downgrade from Plus to Starter, do my archived projects get deleted or just become inaccessible?
response: Downgrading does not delete archived projects. Starter includes fewer active projects, so some older items may become read-only until you bring the workspace within the plan limit. Export anything you need before changing plans. The downgrade takes effect at the end of the current billing period.

human: I changed phones and no longer have the authenticator codes for my Avenlo workspace. The backup codes are on the old phone too.
response: An administrator can verify your identity and clear the existing authenticator enrollment. Ask your Avenlo workspace owner to open Admin Console, choose Members, select your profile, and choose Reset two-step verification. After signing in, enroll the new phone and save the newly generated recovery codes somewhere separate from the device.
