human: My external display is detected by the dock but shows 'unsupported mode' after the laptop wakes from sleep.
response: Disconnect the dock's power and display cable for 30 seconds, then reconnect power before the display cable. In Display Settings, set the external screen to its recommended resolution and a 60 Hz refresh rate. Update the dock firmware if an update is available. If the error returns, provide the laptop model and dock revision.

human: Yesterday’s bank transfer paid invoice VN-80314, but the dashboard still says overdue and has disabled exports.
response: Bank transfers are matched manually and can take up to three business days to appear in the dashboard. Please reply with the invoice number and the transfer reference from your bank confirmation. Do not attach a full bank statement. We can ask billing operations to locate the payment and restore export access once the transfer is confirmed.

human: The repair estimate is almost as much as a new unit. Can I decline the repair and have the device shipped back unrepaired?
response: Yes. You may decline the estimate before authorising paid work. Reply to the repair quotation with Decline and return unrepaired, and include the case number. A return-shipping fee may apply if the device is outside warranty; we will confirm any fee before dispatching it back.

human: During chat, your agent promised the cancellation fee would be waived, but the final bill includes it. I saved the transcript.
response: Please attach the transcript or provide its conversation reference. We will compare the agent's commitment with the account notes and fee calculation. If the waiver was approved but not applied, billing can issue a correction. I will keep the case open until the review result is documented.

human: Does MorrowBoard allow a username instead of my email when signing in to the app?
response: MorrowBoard currently accepts the verified email address associated with the account, not a separate username. You can see that address under Profile, then Account details. If you prefer a different sign-in address, update it there and complete the verification message before your next login.

human: My return label expired while I was away. The 30-day return period has not ended yet. Can you issue another one?
response: Yes, we can regenerate a label while the return window is still open. Go to Returns, reopen the existing request, and select Create new label. If that option is unavailable, reply with the return reference. The new label will be valid for 14 days from issue.

human: The sign-in page keeps saying my password is incorrect, but I reset it this morning. I can still receive mail at the account address.
response: Please check that the browser is not filling an older password from its saved-password manager. Open a private window, enter the new password manually, and confirm that Caps Lock is off. If the message remains, use the account recovery option and provide the case code shown on the screen; do not send us your password.

human: My plan changed automatically after I crossed a data threshold. I only wanted a warning, not an automatic top-up.
response: The account currently has Auto Top-up enabled, which purchases an extra data block when the allowance is nearly used. Open Usage Controls, turn off Auto Top-up, and enable 80 percent and 100 percent alerts instead. The current top-up remains on the account; send us its transaction reference if you believe the setting was enabled without consent.

human: Payment was made with the wrong company account, and I need the receipt issued to a different legal entity. Can the payer be changed?
response: We can correct the billing name and address when the purchasing entity is genuinely the same customer, but we cannot transfer a completed charge between unrelated legal entities. Send the invoice number and the correct entity details for review. We will explain whether a revised invoice is possible before changing the record.

human: The installation fee was paid, but the installer said the required bracket was missing and left without completing the job.
response: The installation should not have been marked complete. I will escalate this to the installation coordinator and request a return visit with the correct bracket. Please share the order number and the installer's appointment reference. We will confirm the new appointment and review any fee charged for the incomplete visit.

human: The wireless door sensor says low battery even after I installed a fresh cell from a sealed pack.
response: Check that the battery type matches the label inside the sensor and that the positive side faces the marked direction. Wipe the contacts with a dry lint-free cloth and close the cover firmly. In the app, open Devices, select the sensor, and choose Refresh status. If the warning remains, send the sensor revision and battery type.

human: My replacement SIM shows 'no service' after activation. The old SIM stopped working, so I cannot receive calls on either one.
response: A replacement SIM can take up to 30 minutes to register after activation. Restart the phone, check that Airplane Mode is off, and select VelaWave under Network Operators if automatic selection fails. If service is still unavailable after an hour, reply with the SIM activation reference and your phone model so we can check the provisioning status.

human: I get a spinning loader after clicking Save, but if I navigate away the change seems to have been stored anyway.
response: The save request may be completing while the confirmation response is delayed. Avoid clicking Save repeatedly, since that can create duplicate actions. Refresh the record and check its updated timestamp. If the timestamp is current, the save succeeded. If not, use Diagnostics to capture the request ID and send it to support.

human: My account is on a free tier, yet there is a 6.99 charge described as a storage add-on.
response: A storage add-on can remain active after the base workspace returns to the free tier. Open Plan and Add-ons, check the storage section, and cancel any add-on you no longer need. If you did not enable it, reply with the charge date and invoice reference so we can check the account activity.

human: My bank replaced my card number, and the old card is still displayed as the default payment method. The new card is saved below it.
response: Open Billing Settings, select the new card, and choose Set as default. You can then remove the old card if it has no pending transactions. A saved replacement is not used automatically until it is marked as default. Check the next renewal date after saving to ensure the change applies to the correct workspace.

human: I opened the seal on a skincare-free personal care appliance, tested it once, and realised it is not suitable. Can it be returned?
response: For hygiene reasons, personal-contact appliances cannot be returned after the protective seal has been opened unless they are faulty. If the device has a defect, select Faulty item in the return portal and describe the problem. We will assess it under the warranty process rather than the change-of-mind policy.

human: A customs message asks me to pay before delivery, even though the order page said duties were included.
response: Your order was placed under the duties-paid shipping option, so you should not owe a second import duty charge for the listed items. Do not pay an unexpected request until it is verified. Send us a screenshot with personal reference numbers obscured, and we will check it with the carrier and provide instructions.

human: Does cancelling a subscription immediately delete our custom templates? We are deciding whether to move to another tool.
response: No. Cancellation stops future renewals, but your templates remain in the workspace through the paid-through date. After that, the workspace becomes read-only for 90 days, during which owners can export templates and project data. The deletion schedule is shown in the cancellation confirmation before you submit it.

human: How do I stop the app from using my approximate location? I only need it for reading saved documents.
response: Yes. In the app, open Settings, select Permissions, and set Location access to Never. You can also revoke location permission in your device's operating-system settings. Saved documents remain available; location access is used only for nearby service suggestions and optional check-in features.

human: Please disconnect the social sign-in connection and let me use a password going forward. Will I lose my saved projects?
response: Your projects are attached to your Avenlo account, not to the social sign-in provider. While signed in, open Security, choose Set password, and complete the email verification. Then use Connected sign-in methods to disconnect the provider. Test a password login before removing the connection, and keep your recovery email current.

human: The password reset email arrived, but the button opens a page saying the request has expired. I clicked it less than five minutes later.
response: Only the newest reset link remains valid, so an earlier email can expire as soon as another request is made. Return to the sign-in page, request one fresh link, and open the latest message without requesting another. The link is valid for 30 minutes. If your mail app previews links automatically, copy the button address into a browser instead.

human: Where can I correct my date of birth in the account? The profile form does not let me edit it after verification?
response: Date of birth is locked after identity verification to prevent unauthorised account changes. Submit a Profile correction request through Privacy Centre and provide the account ID plus the reason for correction. We will explain which verification document, if any, is required. Do not email identity documents unless the secure upload page requests them.

human: I accidentally made two profiles with the same name. Can support merge them so my saved preferences are in one place?
response: We can review a possible account consolidation, but profiles cannot be merged automatically. Please identify which account should remain by its sign-in email and provide the other account's email. We will check ownership and explain which preferences can be transferred before making any change. Do not send either account's password.

human: The MorrowBoard dashboard takes nearly a minute to open, but individual project pages load normally once I get past it.
response: Please test the dashboard in a private browser window and temporarily disable extensions that modify page content. Then open Settings, choose Diagnostics, and copy the performance ID from the latest slow load. We will use that ID to inspect the dashboard request. If the issue occurs only with a large workspace, mention its approximate project count.

human: The portal rejects my prepaid card even though it has enough balance. Are prepaid cards blocked?
response: VellumNote accepts most credit and debit cards, but some prepaid cards do not support recurring merchant transactions or address verification. Try a card that supports subscriptions, or choose bank debit if it is available in your region. We cannot see or change the issuer's decline reason; your card provider can confirm whether recurring payments are permitted.

human: I cancelled a CloudHarbor add-on last week, but this month's invoice still includes it. Can you check the date?
response: The add-on was active at the start of the billing period, so the current invoice includes the full period under the plan terms. Cancellation prevents the next renewal and does not remove a charge already generated. I can review the cancellation timestamp if you provide the invoice number and the add-on name shown on it.

human: I keep receiving generic replies that do not answer whether my service is available at the new address. This is the only thing I need confirmed.
response: Understood. I will route the request to address qualification and ask for a yes-or-no coverage result before discussing plan options. Please provide the service-check reference or the postal code and unit type through the secure form. We will respond with the availability result and any installation conditions.
